title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — October 08, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C3.5 (Peaked October 08, 2026 at 22:44 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M6.7 (Peaked October 08, 2026 at 15:48 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 363 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
